name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A Climb and Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and +5 to Athletics checks to climb or swim.
text: While you wear these gloves, your Speed also serves as your Climb Speed and Swim Speed, and you add +5 to Strength (Athletics) checks for climbing or swimming.
